question.problem:
Consider the following system of linear equations:

$$
\{\begin{aligned} & x+2y+z=-4 \\  & y+z=-2 \\  & z=0\end{aligned}
$$

Use the standard Gauss-Jordan method to reduce the augmented matrix $M$ of the system to reduced row echelon form.
question.worked_solution:
The augmented matrix for this system is

$$
M=[\begin{aligned}1 & 2 & 1 & -4 \\ 0 & 1 & 1 & -2 \\ 0 & 0 & 1 & 0\end{aligned}].
$$

Notice that the matrix $M$ is already in row echelon form.

Transforming $M$ to reduced row echelon form, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}M & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & 2 & 1 & -4 \\ 0 & 1 & 1 & -2 \\ 0 & 0 & 1 & 0\end{aligned}] & {R}_{2} & :={R}_{2}+(-1){R}_{3} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & 2 & 1 & -4 \\ 0 & 1 & 0 & -2 \\ 0 & 0 & 1 & 0\end{aligned}] & {R}_{1} & :={R}_{1}+(-1){R}_{3} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & 2 & 0 & -4 \\ 0 & 1 & 0 & -2 \\ 0 & 0 & 1 & 0\end{aligned}] & {R}_{1} & :={R}_{1}+(-2){R}_{2} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & 0 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 1 & 0 & -2 \\ 0 & 0 & 1 & 0\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$
